## Maribelle — *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic* (G4)

Maribelle is an obscure background Earth-pony mare: look for a pale buttery-yellow coat, a light powder-blue mane and tail, pale aqua eyes, and a cutie mark of **three orange thread spools**. She is easiest to place in Granny Smith-era flashbacks and as one of the performers in Manehattan's *Hinny of the Hills*. She shares a character design with **Candy Twirl**, but they are not verified to be the same pony. [Background-pony catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Mares).

**Name and voice:** “Maribelle” is a fandom/wiki identification, **not a verified on-screen or Hasbro-issued name**; I could not confirm who originally coined it. No individual spoken dialogue or voice-actor credit could be verified for her. No alter ego is established.

## Important moments

Because she is an unnamed background extra, these are her **most identifiable appearances**, not independently developed plot turns. No verified full-episode scene timestamps were found.

- **An old Ponyville memory — [“Bats!” (S4E7)](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Bats%21).** Maribelle appears in a sepia-toned flashback, placing her design among ponies from Granny Smith's younger days. *Timestamp unavailable.*
- **On the Bridleway stage — [“Rarity Takes Manehattan” (S4E8)](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Rarity_Takes_Manehattan).** She appears as an actress in *Hinny of the Hills*, the musical central to Rarity's attempt to make things right with her friends. *Timestamp unavailable.*
- **Another look at Granny Smith's past — [“Leap of Faith” (S4E20)](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Leap_of_Faith).** She turns up again in Granny Smith's recollections. *Timestamp unavailable.*

She is also cataloged in a flashback in [“No Second Prances” (S6E6)](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/No_Second_Prances), without an independently verified speaking part.
